why: MI-280 unit U6. Fixes scripts/ops/stuck_automation_branches.py plus two backlog rows. Tier-1 by the canonical list: scripts/ops/** and docs/ only — no src/, no config/, no deploy/, no order path, no strategy config, no risk cap. R12 does not apply, and that was CHECKED BY IMPORTING check_pr_landing.py AND PRINTING ALL 11 ENTRIES rather than by grepping — the same session published a false absence earlier today from a truncated grep, so the method matters: stuck_automation_branches.py is not among them. THE DEFECT: classify() decided `landed` from `git merge-base --is-ancestor` ALONE, and this repo SQUASH-MERGES every PR, so a branch that landed perfectly reads as not landed. ESTABLISHED BY A CONTROLLED EXPERIMENT, not by reading code: one branch, one payload, squash-merged into a local main -> --is-ancestor exit 1 ('not landed') while the payload is byte-present, git diff shows 0 differing files, and git cherry prints '- <sha>'; the same branch merged with a MERGE COMMIT returns exit 0. ⚠️ AND THE OBVIOUS HEADLINE IS WRONG AND IS NOT PUBLISHED. `landed` fires ZERO times out of 184 on the live remote, and I expected the squash trap to explain nearly all of them. Re-measured deployed-vs-fixed over the SAME 184 on a FULL clone: 184 stuck -> 181 stuck + 3 landed. The trap is worth 3 of 184 (1.6%) — merged automation branches are normally pruned, so the survivors are mostly genuinely unlanded, and 181 branches ARE genuinely stranded. The three are automation/grade-order-packages-{28025099518,28027973367,28037490394}. Corrected against my own expectation rather than shipped as a big number. ⚠️ WHERE THE DEFECT IS TOTAL IS ON A SHALLOW CLONE, WHICH IS WHAT ANY CARRIER GETS: actions/checkout@v4 defaults to fetch-depth 1. Measured on this container while shallow, deployed reports stuck 184 / unknown 0 — 184 CONFIDENT findings over a population whose containment is not knowable from a truncated history — and fixed reports stuck 0 / unknown 184, each row naming the remedy (fetch-depth: 0). THE FIX: containment() with FOUR never-collapsed states — ancestor / patch_equivalent / not_contained / undecidable. Only not_contained may become `stuck`; undecidable reaches `unknown`, never the age test. Shallowness makes an AMBIGUOUS read undecidable and deliberately does NOT suppress a decisive one (a patch-equivalent branch still grades landed on a shallow clone), which is pinned by its own control. ⚠️ THE SELF-TEST'S OWN DOCSTRING PROMISED THE CONTROL THAT WOULD HAVE CAUGHT THIS — 'the load-bearing one is the POSITIVE control: if a known-landed branch stops classifying as landed ... it short-circuits' — and the body contained NO such control. That is why it went uncaught, and it is filed as its own row. The control now BUILDS a real repository and performs a real squash merge, because the rule was never in doubt; the repo's merge STYLE was. VERIFICATION: self-test 9 -> 17 cases, all passing. Mutation run 8/8 caught on the second pass, positive control quiet. ⚠️ THE FIRST PASS CAUGHT ONLY 5 OF 8 and all three escapes were the SAME SHAPE — a control that cannot reach the branch it targets, which is the defect being fixed, in my own suite. Two were closed with new controls (undecidable reaching `unknown` through classify; a git call that FAILS rather than answers 'no'); the third turned out to be UNREACHABLE dead code (a non-ancestor always has at least one commit in the range) and was DELETED rather than left as handled-looking. ⚠️ One mutation is WEAK and is recorded as neither an escape nor a catch: removing the merge-base-failure refusal changes only the message, because a sha that breaks merge-base also breaks git cherry and the second refusal returns the same undecidable — measured side by side, not assumed. NOT DONE, AND FILED RATHER THAN GLOSSED: the probe is still wired to NOTHING (zero callers), so 181 stranded branches remain seen by nobody on any cadence. That is a carrier, it is a separate concern, and its obvious implementation is the fetch-depth trap above — filed as BL-20260912-THE-STUCK-BRANCH-PROBE-IS-WIRED-TO-NOTHING-... rather than bundled into this PR.
